content.comment_body: Good evening, I downloaded [product_name] software from [url] and installed it on [company_name] PG device. When I try to create a project, I receive an error message. Can someone assist me? Thanks.
Did you install [product_name] as an administrator? Is your Java installation up to date?

Similar to [product_name], you should install as Administrator (select 'Run as Administrator' from the menu). Make sure your operating system is compatible—at least Windows 7 is needed for [product_name]. It’s best not to run other applications during the installation.
Hi, I believe my Java is current. I installed [product_name] with administrator rights.

My operating system is Windows 7 64-bit. I installed the 64-bit version of [product_name]. I've already uninstalled and reinstalled the software, but the error keeps appearing. Could another program be causing a conflict?
I have Windows 7 Professional SP1 64-bit and did not encounter any issues installing [product_name].
After multiple install and uninstall attempts, the software now works, but occasionally I get the same error when searching for a function. I have also tried uninstalling Java.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report persistent errors installing and using [product_name] on [company_name] PG devices running Windows 7 64-bit. Steps like running as administrator and verifying Java do not consistently resolve the issues, particularly during function searches. Sometimes the installation succeeds, but recurring errors affect usability and lead to frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect seamless installation and reliable performance of [product_name] on compatible operating systems, with no errors during tasks such as project creation and function searches.
